notes: The v6 driver and matching helper passed independent ELF and embedded-code inspection before import.
Embedded AIDL Effect V4/common V5 and legacy AELI share one driver; control protocol remains 3.
Android factory compatibility, SELinux behavior and real audio processing remain unverified for this build.

Soundstage now uses a stateless linear mid/side matrix instead of nonlinear multiband centre extraction. Parameter scale and pure-mid/pure-side gains are retained, while mixed stereo response intentionally changes.
Width 50 is exact bypass. Strict/fast-math/sanitizer spectral tests pass; the frozen previous Soundstage fails the same bass-plus-treble gate as an expected diagnostic control.
Other effects, generic filterbank users, scheduler watcher and APK are unchanged. This new build still requires Android listening validation, including bass-heavy music and Dynamic Bass Boost.
